firm_note.text: ARQ Wealth Advisors was founded in July 2008 — during the depths of the financial crisis — by advisors who left large institutions (including Vanguard) to build an independent, fee-only RIA focused on client service without corporate conflicts. Now manages roughly $844M for high-net-worth clients out of Scottsdale, AZ, with a team averaging 15+ years of experience and 3,000+ financial plans implemented.
firm_note.source: arqwealth.com (firm site) corroborated by CAEPC member directory and multiple advisor-network profiles (smartadvisormatch.com, theadvisoros.com) describing the 2008 founding and Vanguard lineage of its partners

Richard Alan Siegel.bio_note: Co-founder and Managing Partner of ARQ Wealth Advisors, CFP since 2001, in the industry since 1996. Before co-founding ARQ, he was a Senior Financial Planner at The Vanguard Group, developing investment, retirement, and estate strategies for affluent investors, including Fortune 500 executives and dot-com-era millionaires. Graduate of SUNY Albany (psychology and business administration, 1991). Originally from New York; moved to Scottsdale in 1995.
Richard Alan Siegel.bio_source: linkedin.com/in/rich-siegel-cfp-87720549 (title/role corroborated); detailed career narrative from arqwealth.com/rich-siegel and independent advisor-network listing smartadvisormatch.com/advisor-network/arizona/richard-siegel-2857109

James Nelson Robinson.bio_note: Co-founder and Partner at ARQ Wealth Advisors, Director of Business Development. Goes by 'Jay.' Entered financial services in 2004; before becoming an advisor, was the #1-ranked wholesaler for a $3B+ independent broker-dealer. Holds RICP and AIF designations. Attended University of Mississippi and graduated with honors from University of Texas at El Paso (psychology and business management). Has appeared as a financial contributor on ABC, NBC, CBS, FOX, and CNN, and teaches retirement/estate planning and Social Security classes at local colleges. Originally from Harrisonburg, VA; relocated to Scottsdale in 2006.
James Nelson Robinson.bio_source: linkedin.com/in/james-robinson-ricp-aif-17b3b32a, independent of the firm's own site

Gregory Courtland Yocum.bio_note: Co-founder of ARQ Wealth Advisors and current Chief Compliance Officer, per SEC filing. CFP since 2004 (21+ years in the industry), added AIF in 2016. Bachelor's in business administration from Northern Arizona University (1998). Before ARQ, was a Senior Investment Manager at The Vanguard Group managing portfolios for high-net-worth clients.

Carl Steven Mariner.bio_note: Partner and Director of Strategic Planning at ARQ Wealth Advisors, holding CFA, CFP, and ChFC designations. Previously a Relationship Manager for ultra-high-net-worth families at Vanguard, and before that built his own investment advisory practice at a broker-dealer. Originally from Northern Michigan; relocated to the Phoenix area in 2009 with his wife, Emily.
Carl Steven Mariner.bio_source: Carl Mariner's LinkedIn profile, title/credentials independently corroborated

William Darrell Lee.bio_note: Wealth Advisor & Portfolio Manager at ARQ Wealth Advisors (CFA, CFP), in the industry since 2003. Earned CFP in 2009 and CFA in 2014. Graduated cum laude from Arizona State University's W.P. Carey School of Business (finance) and holds a master's degree in security analysis and portfolio management from Creighton University. Named a 'Five Star Wealth Manager' annually from 2015-2025, recognized as a 'Top Financial Planner' by the Consumer Research Council of America (2014), and has been featured in the Wall Street Journal and Forbes. Past President of both the CFA Society of Phoenix and the Central Arizona Estate Planning Council.
William Darrell Lee.bio_source: money.usnews.com/financial-advisors/advisor/william-lee-4748764 (U.S. News advisor profile) and caepc.org/members/member/109893 (Central Arizona Estate Planning Council directory), both independent of the firm's own site

firm_note.text: DeGreen Private Wealth launched in August 2024 in Scottsdale as an independent, fee-only fiduciary RIA, built on a 30-year family tradition of wealth management (following the sale of the founder's prior firm, DeGreen Wealth Management, to Allworth Financial in 2021). The firm specializes in low-cost, tax-efficient, diversified ETF portfolios and partners with Charles Schwab for custody. Manages roughly $133M.
firm_note.source: accessnewswire.com press release 'DeGreen Private Wealth LLC Opens Its Doors in Scottsdale, Arizona' (also syndicated on newswire.com and europeanbusinessmagazine.com) — independent of the firm's own website

Sam Howard DeGreen.bio_note: Founder, CEO, and CCO of DeGreen Private Wealth, launched August 2024. Series 65-licensed with about seven years in the industry; previously an investment advisor alongside his father at DeGreen Wealth Management, which was acquired by Allworth Financial in 2021. Builds the new firm around low-cost, transparent, tax-efficient ETF portfolios continuing a 30-year family tradition in wealth management. Hosts a weekly radio show/podcast, 'Freedom Through Finance,' Saturdays 6-7pm MST on News Talk 550 KFYI.
Sam Howard DeGreen.bio_source: accessnewswire.com press release on the firm's 2024 launch, corroborated by linkedin.com/in/sam-degreen-07309412b and SEC IAPD individual report (reports.adviserinfo.sec.gov/reports/individual/individual_6932311.pdf)

firm_note.text: L. Roy Papp & Associates, LLP is a Phoenix investment counseling firm founded in 1977-1979 by L. Roy Papp, a former U.S. director and ambassador to the Asian Development Bank. Now led by his son Harry Papp and daughter Rosellen Papp, the firm manages roughly $1.4-1.6B and is known for the Papp mutual funds. The Papp family is prominent in Phoenix philanthropy (Phoenix Art Museum's Marilyn and L. Roy Papp Family Gallery, arts, education).

Harry A Papp.bio_note: Managing Partner & Portfolio Manager; son of founder L. Roy Papp and Marilyn Papp. With the firm since 1981, over four decades in portfolio management. Previously in G.D. Searle & Co.'s Treasurer's Office handling overseas financing and domestic real estate. Holds an AB from Brown University and an MBA (Finance/Accounting) and MS (Geochemistry) from the University of Chicago. Serves on the Arizona State Board of Investment (oversees $11B+ in state investments), is former board chair of Blue Cross/Blue Shield Arizona, vice-chair of the Arizona Public Safety Personnel Retirement System board, and a trustee of the Phoenix Zoo and ASU Foundation.
Harry A Papp.bio_source: roypapp.com/partners.html; independently corroborated by historicalleague.org/historymakers/harry-papp (AZ Historymaker oral history bio) and linkedin.com/in/harry-papp-75875423

Rosellen C Papp.bio_note: Partner & Research Director, CFA charterholder; daughter of founder L. Roy Papp, sister of Harry Papp. Joined the firm in 1981 after moving from Illinois, where she supervised strategic planning in G.D. Searle & Co.'s pharmaceutical group. Manages the Papp Small & Mid-Cap Growth Fund. Holds a BBA from University of Michigan and an MBA from Northwestern's Kellogg School of Management. Serves on the Flinn Foundation board (joined 1998, treasurer 2005, vice chair 2023), is a Phoenix Art Museum trustee, and past director of Ballet Arizona.
Rosellen C Papp.bio_source: roypapp.com/team.html; independently corroborated by flinn.org/flinn-staff/rosellen-c-papp-c-f-a (Flinn Foundation staff bio) and historicalleague.org/historymakers/rosellen-papp

Jeffrey Nels Edwards.bio_note: Partner & Portfolio Manager, CFA charterholder. Joined L. Roy Papp & Associates in 1987 after starting his career in 1982 as a Trust Investment Officer at FirsTier Bank in Lincoln, Nebraska, trading government, corporate and municipal bonds. Holds an MBA in Finance from the University of Nebraska and a BA in Business Administration from Hastings College; was a 1981 NAIA Track & Field All-American. Serves as a Wharton Foundation trustee.

Christopher Lauren Schaefer.bio_note: Partner & Senior Portfolio Manager, CFA charterholder. Began his financial career in 1997 and joined L. Roy Papp & Associates as an associate in 2005, after managing portfolios at Wells Fargo Private Client Services; earlier background includes risk analyst/senior auditor work at USAA. Holds a BS in Finance from Arizona State University. Former president and board member of the Phoenix CFA Society; serves on the Florence Crittenton board.

Brian Michael Riordan.bio_note: Partner & Research Analyst, CFA charterholder. Joined L. Roy Papp & Associates in 2004, with financial industry experience dating to 1997. Co-manages the Papp Small & Mid-Cap Growth Fund. Prior roles at Neuberger Berman, Sanford C. Bernstein, and IBM. Holds an MBA from Arizona State University and a BS from Villanova University.
Brian Michael Riordan.bio_source: roypapp.com/team.html (firm website only — a genuine search for independent corroboration on LinkedIn, press, or industry directories did not turn up a specific, matching independent profile for this individual)

firm_note.text: Wealth Management Solutions is a fee-only fiduciary RIA in Scottsdale, AZ (~$173M AUM), founded by David Rosenthal after he managed the wealth management division of a national CPA firm's Arizona practice.

David Scott Rosenthal.bio_note: Founder, CCO, Principal and Senior Financial Advisor, CFP. Began his career advising Fortune 500 corporate executives on investment management and employee benefits (stock options, RSUs, deferred compensation). Relocated to Arizona in 2000 to manage the wealth management division of a national CPA firm, developing a specialty serving business owners, before founding Wealth Management Solutions. Holds a BS in Finance and an MBA from Seton Hall University. Active in NAPFA, the Financial Planning Association, and the PVEPG study group.

firm_note.text: SLT Capital LLC operates as SL Capital, a boutique wealth management firm in Scottsdale founded by Zachary Brodt, offering investment strategies, private wealth management, estate planning, and risk management to high-net-worth families.
firm_note.source: slcapitalwealth.com (firm website); independently listed on U.S. News Financial Advisors at money.usnews.com/financial-advisors/advisor/zachary-brodt-5228473

Zachary Stuart Brodt.bio_note: Founder and CEO of SL Capital in Scottsdale. Earned a finance degree from Arizona State University and built his career at UBS, Raymond James, and Gentry Wealth Management before serving as Managing Director at First Equity Financial. Launched SL Capital (via SLT Capital LLC) in December 2019 to build a boutique, client-centric wealth management practice for affluent families.
Zachary Stuart Brodt.bio_source: U.S. News Financial Advisors profile (money.usnews.com/financial-advisors/advisor/zachary-brodt-5228473) and LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/zach-brodt-3502b8280/), corroborating career history also described on the firm's own site

Marcus John Pimentel.bio_note: Chief Compliance Officer and Private Wealth Manager at SL Capital, with the firm since September 2023. Grew up in Phoenix and attended Brophy College Preparatory before going to Washington University in St. Louis, where he was captain of the Division II lacrosse team and an Academic All-Conference honoree. Landed an internship with the SL Capital team while at WashU that turned into full-time employment after graduation. Holds a Series 65 license.
Marcus John Pimentel.bio_source: SmartAdvisorMatch advisor profile (smartadvisormatch.com/advisor-network/arizona/marcus-pimentel-7265602), an independent advisor-directory source corroborating firm bio details

Marisa Marie Brodt.bio_note: Listed on SLT Capital's Form ADV as Trustee of the SLT Trust, an indirect owner of the firm. Genuine search effort (web search, LinkedIn, firm site, U.S. News, directories) turned up no independent, verifiable profile for this specific individual — searches surfaced only unrelated people with the same name. The shared surname with Zachary Brodt suggests a possible family connection, but this could not be confirmed by any source and should not be assumed.
Marisa Marie Brodt.bio_source: None found — no independent source beyond the SEC Form ADV ownership disclosure

Victor Pasqual Sesate.bio_note: Listed on SLT Capital's Form ADV as an Independent Trustee of the SLT Trust, an indirect owner of the firm — a role that is typically a professional/fiduciary service position rather than an operating executive at SL Capital. Genuine search effort (web search, LinkedIn, firm site, directories) found no independent, verifiable profile that can be confidently matched to this specific individual (a ZoomInfo listing for a same-named Fidelity VP/Managing Director could not be corroborated as the same person).
Victor Pasqual Sesate.bio_source: None found — no independent source beyond the SEC Form ADV ownership disclosure

firm_note.text: Biltmore Wealth Management, LLC is a Tempe-based RIA co-founded in January 2010 by Timothy Carpenter and Kevin Sweeney, managing roughly $440M for individuals, with a niche practice advising professional athletes.
firm_note.source: biltmorewealthaz.com/about-us/ (firm website), independently corroborated by Kevin Sweeney's LinkedIn profile (linkedin.com/in/kevin-sweeney-cfp-04306522/)

Timothy Alan Carpenter.bio_note: Managing Member and Portfolio Manager at Biltmore Wealth Management, with the firm since January 2010. Started his financial career at Dean Witter three decades ago after an earlier career as a maintenance supervisor for Republic Airlines (now Delta), where he held an FAA Airframe and Powerplant certification. Holds a degree in Aviation Maintenance Technology from Vincennes University, took coursework at Eastern Michigan University, Harper College, Arizona State University, and Wharton, and completed CIMA training. Outside of work he is an instrument-rated pilot, certified SCUBA diver, and classical guitarist.
Timothy Alan Carpenter.bio_source: Firm website (biltmorewealthaz.com/about-us) — attempted independent corroboration via LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, and web search, but found no independent profile beyond the firm's own materials for Carpenter specifically (unlike co-founder Sweeney, whose bio is echoed on LinkedIn)

Kevin John Sweeney.bio_note: Chief Compliance Officer, Member, and financial advisor at Biltmore Wealth Management, with the firm since January 2010 (previously a Financial Advisor at Morgan Stanley from 1999-2010). A Buffalo, NY native, he played baseball at Mercyhurst College on scholarship, earning NCAA Division II All-American and three-time All-Region honors, and a finance degree. The Arizona Diamondbacks drafted him in the 29th round; he played three minor-league seasons in their organization, leading the league with a .424 batting average and winning Pioneer League MVP as a rookie. He discovered his advisory career during baseball off-seasons working as a Personal Banking Consultant for Bank One, which led him to specialize in financial planning for professional athletes. Holds the CFP certification and remains active in baseball as a high school coach.
Kevin John Sweeney.bio_source: LinkedIn profile (linkedin.com/in/kevin-sweeney-cfp-04306522/), an independent source corroborating the career and baseball narrative also told on the firm's website

firm_note.text: GPS Investments (legally Global Portfolio Solutions, Inc., dba GPS Investments) is a Scottsdale RIA managing about $128M for roughly 85 clients, founded by William Jones and registered with the SEC in 2024, though Jones has run the Global Portfolio Solutions brand since 1997. No independent firm website with a team/about page was found beyond directory listings and Jones' longstanding Global Portfolio Solutions site.
firm_note.source: SEC IAPD firm summary (adviserinfo.sec.gov/firm/summary/333381) and FINRA/SEC individual disclosure for William Joseph Jones (reports.adviserinfo.sec.gov/reports/individual/individual_1943251.pdf), independent regulatory sources

William Joseph Jones.bio_note: Founder and CEO of GPS Investments, with the firm since September 2024, though his affiliated brand Global Portfolio Solutions dates to November 1997 at the same Scottsdale address. Holds the CFP credential and is broadly licensed for both insurance and securities across more than a dozen states, reflecting a long, multi-state advisory practice. Operates today through Mutual Advisors, LLC (dba Global Portfolio Solutions) alongside GPS Investments.
William Joseph Jones.bio_source: SEC IAPD individual disclosure report for CRD 1943251 (reports.adviserinfo.sec.gov/reports/individual/individual_1943251.pdf) and U.S. News Financial Advisors listing (money.usnews.com/financial-advisors/advisor/william-jones-1943251), corroborated by gpsinvest.com

Trevor Robert Cross.bio_note: Chief Compliance Officer at GPS Investments, with the firm since September 2024 (registered as adviser representative November 2024). Holds a Series 66 license and has about seven years in the industry, with prior roles at Fortune Financial Services, Mutual Securities, Inc., Mutual Advisors, LLC, and Massachusetts Mutual Life Insurance Co. before joining GPS Investments; dually registered with Fortune Financial Services as of September 2025.
Trevor Robert Cross.bio_source: SEC IAPD individual disclosure for CRD 6977085 (adviserinfo.sec.gov/individual/summary/6977085), an independent regulatory source

firm_note.text: Juncture Wealth Strategies was founded in 2010 by Barry Rhonemus after he and colleagues left Wells Fargo Private Bank to go independent; the firm serves ultra-high-net-worth individuals, family offices, foundations, and corporate entities. A related advisory entity, Juncture Asset Management, LLC (est. 2019), is also owned by Rhonemus, Barker, and Haines.

Jack Andrew Barker.bio_note: Chief Fiduciary Officer / Chief Compliance Officer at Juncture Wealth Strategies (JD, CPA, CTFA). Over 20 years of experience in tax consulting, wealth planning, and trust administration for high-net-worth clients. Career includes implementing tax strategies at a national accounting firm, supervising client relationships at an asset management practice, and managing trust operations at a multinational bank. Holds a J.D. from the University of Nebraska College of Law (1994); joined Juncture in 2013.
Jack Andrew Barker.bio_source: Firm website (juncturewealth.com/about/team) corroborated by Juncture's 2024 Form ADV Part 2B Brochure Supplement and Bloomberg Markets profile (bloomberg.com/profile/person/19154180)

Barry Scott Rhonemus.bio_note: Managing Partner and Founder of Juncture Wealth Strategies. Over 20 years of experience serving ultra-high-net-worth clients, family offices, foundations, and corporate entities. Spent more than a decade as a private bank wealth advisor at Wells Fargo, where he ranked in the Top 10 of Wells Fargo Private Bank Wealth Advisors nationally, before founding Juncture in 2010. Holds a bachelor's degree from Ohio University (1984-1988) and is active mentoring emerging business leaders through organizations like Spilt Social.
Barry Scott Rhonemus.bio_source: Firm website (juncturewealth.com/about/team) corroborated by LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/barry-rhonemus-12b9883b) confirming Wells Fargo tenure, Top 10 ranking, and Ohio University education

Bradley James Haines.bio_note: Chief Investment Officer at Juncture Wealth Strategies (CFA, FRM). Over 20 years of experience managing investment portfolios for high-net-worth individuals and institutional clients, with expertise in valuing privately held companies and researching asset/risk allocation strategies. Prior experience includes roles at Wells Fargo, LeMaster & Daniels PLLC (now CliftonLarsonAllen LLP), and Merrill Lynch.
Bradley James Haines.bio_source: Firm website (juncturewealth.com/about/team) corroborated by LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/bradhainescfafrm/) listing prior roles at Wells Fargo, LeMaster & Daniels, and Merrill Lynch

firm_note.text: Galvin, Gaustad & Stein, LLC was established in 2010 and is managed by its three named principals; the firm reported $1.22B AUM as of year-end 2024 and has expanded to offices in Beverly Hills, New York, Seattle, Denver, and Cleveland.

Mark Paul Stein.bio_note: Principal at Galvin, Gaustad & Stein (CLU, CFP). Longtime Chartered Life Underwriter and CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER professional with over 30 years in the financial industry (career start 1985 per industry records). Prior to co-founding the firm, was President of AeGIS Financial Group, Inc. for 18 years. A nationally recognized public speaker for accounting and consumer groups, serves on the Arizona Family College Savings Program Oversight Committee (Arizona's 529 Plan), and is a past President of the Greater Phoenix Financial Planning Association.
Mark Paul Stein.bio_source: Firm website (ggsadvisors.com) corroborated by Beverly Hills Chamber of Commerce member profile (members.beverlyhillschamber.com/list/member/galvin-gaustad-stein-llc-wealth-management-mark-p-stein-cfp-clu-principal-54943), which details his AeGIS Financial Group presidency and industry leadership roles

Stephen Lee Gaustad.bio_note: Principal at Galvin, Gaustad & Stein. Investment Advisor Representative with over 28 years of experience in the finance industry. Co-manages the firm alongside Mark Stein and Stephen Galvin.
Stephen Lee Gaustad.bio_source: Firm website (ggsadvisors.com) corroborated by SEC Investment Adviser Public Disclosure record (adviserinfo.sec.gov/individual/summary/1346615) and Wealthminder advisor profile (wealthminder.com/financial-advisors-scottsdale-AZ/stephen-gaustad/75162) — no narrative career detail beyond tenure found independently

Stephen Richard Galvin.bio_note: Principal at Galvin, Gaustad & Stein. Investment Advisor Representative who began his finance career in 1985, roughly 40 years of industry experience. Co-manages the firm alongside Mark Stein and Stephen Gaustad.
Stephen Richard Galvin.bio_source: Firm website (ggsadvisors.com) corroborated by SEC Investment Adviser Public Disclosure record (adviserinfo.sec.gov/individual/summary/1346615) noting 1985 career start — no narrative career detail beyond tenure found independently

firm_note.text: Fortitude Family Office was founded in 2021 by Matt Walker and has grown to over $2B in assets under administration ($741.7M AUM per SEC filing), serving high- and ultra-high-net-worth families with integrated investment, tax, accounting, and family office services. Per its Form CRS, the firm is owned through its parent, Fortitude Family Office Holdco, LLC, 'by its managers and employees' — this filing language does not by itself confirm Walker individually as the controlling person behind Holdco; that remains unresolved (see note on Matthew Walker below).

Matthew Gene Walker.bio_note: Founder & CEO of Fortitude Family Office (CPA, CGMA). Founded the firm in 2021 to provide direct, meaningful wealth solutions for high- and ultra-high-net-worth families. Holds an M.S. in Taxation and a B.S. in Accountancy, both from Arizona State University. Received significant independent industry recognition: named to Five Star Professional's 2023 Five Star Wealth Manager list, honored as an InvestmentNews Awards 2024 Excellence Awardee (Advisor of the Year, Southwest region), and named Executive of the Year by the Business Intelligence Group in 2024. UNRESOLVED OWNERSHIP QUESTION (per Phase 2 flag): SEC/ADV filings show Walker as a 75%+ owner via Fortitude Partner Holdings LLC. A separate entity, Fortitude Family Office Holdco, LLC, also holds 75%+ ownership; the firm's Form CRS describes Holdco as owned collectively 'by its managers and employees' rather than naming an individual. No AZ Corporation Commission filing or press coverage was found naming Walker specifically as the majority owner/controlling person behind Holdco. A genuine search (AZCC records, press) did not resolve this either way — left flagged as unresolved rather than guessed.
Matthew Gene Walker.bio_source: Firm website (fortitudefo.com/team/) corroborated by three PR Newswire releases confirming Founder/CEO title and awards (Five Star Wealth Manager 2023: prnewswire.com/news-releases/fortitude-family-offices-announces-founder-and-chief-executive-officer-matt-walker-has-been-named-to-the-five-star-wealth-managers-2023-list-302029706.html; InvestmentNews Excellence Award: prnewswire.com/news-releases/matt-walker-fortitude-family-office-founder-and-ceo-honored-as-investmentnews-excellence-awardee-302175687.html; Business Intelligence Group Executive of the Year: prnewswire.com/news-releases/fortitude-family-office-founder-and-ceo-matt-walker-named-executive-of-the-year-by-business-intelligence-group-302117711.html)

Dale Andrew Phillips.bio_note: Chief Operating Officer, Partner ('Drew Phillips') at Fortitude Family Office (CFA). Oversees investment strategy, compliance, technology operations, regulatory compliance, risk management, and trading, with 15+ years in the industry. Before Fortitude, was Director of Operations at Tarbox Family Office, and earlier held roles at MRA Associates, Keats Connelly, InPulse Response Group, and Discover. Holds a B.S. in Finance from Arizona State University and an MBA in Finance from Grand Canyon University.
Dale Andrew Phillips.bio_source: Firm website (fortitudefo.com/team/) corroborated by LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/drew-phillips-cfa/) and TipRanks expert profile (tipranks.com/experts/hedge-funds/drew-phillips) listing his prior roles at Tarbox Family Office, MRA Associates, Keats Connelly, and Discover

James Coons.bio_note: Senior Director, Tax, Partner at Fortitude Family Office (CPA, JD). Coordinates daily tax practice operations, providing tax and financial planning guidance to ultra-high-net-worth clients, with 10+ years in the industry. Holds a J.D. in Tax Law/Taxation from the University of Arizona James E. Rogers College of Law and an M.S. in Taxation from Arizona State University.
James Coons.bio_source: Firm website (fortitudefo.com/team/) corroborated by U.S. News legal directory profile (law.usnews.com/law-firms/lawyers/james-coons-111181) confirming his J.D. in Tax Law from University of Arizona
